name: "Build Your Own" Mac & Cheese with Bacon Bits, Pepperoni, Broccoli, Peas & Olives (Kid-Friendly)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe contains steps that can be done by smaller hands! You know your child (and their cooking abilities) best, so get them involved where you feel comfortable. Have fun!

TO MAKE THE MACARONI & CHEESE: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap). Add salt, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, uncover, add pasta, and stir for a few seconds; cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain pasta and set aside.
Meanwhile, coarsely grate cheese. Place 1 cup cheese in a small bowl and set aside as a topping. Reserve remaining cheese for the sauce.
Preheat another large pot over medium heat.
Once the pot is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add flour and whisk until smooth. Cook, whisking frequently, for 1 minute.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup butter, unsalted
¼ cup all-purpose flour

instructions.primary_message: Slowly pour half & half and milk into the pot, whisking constantly. Continue whisking until the sauce has thickened, 4-5 minutes more.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cups half & half
1 cup whole milk

instructions.primary_message: Add reserved grated cheese and spices to the pot, then whisk until cheese is melted and sauce is smooth, 2-3 minutes. Remove cheese sauce from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper
¼ tsp garlic powder

instructions.primary_message: Add cooked pasta to the pot with the cheese sauce and stir to combine the macaroni & cheese. Cover to keep warm and set aside.

TO MAKE THE TOPPINGS: Place broccoli bag on a microwave-safe plate and pierce with a fork. Place in the microwave and cook on high, until tender, 4-5 minutes. Remove plate from microwave and carefully open the bag. Roughly chop broccoli and return to the plate.
Rinse peas under hot, running water (from the tap). Drain well, then add to the plate with the broccoli.
Cut pepperoni into bite-sized pieces. Add to the plate.
Drain olives. Add to the plate along with bacon bits.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (2.25 oz) can sliced black olives
½ cup bacon bits

instructions.primary_message: TO BUILD YOUR OWN: Divide macaroni & cheese between 6 bowls, let each person add their choice of toppings, and stir to combine. Place each person's creation in its own small baking dish (or oven-safe ramekin) and top with more cheese. Place dishes in the preheated oven and bake until cheese is melted and bubbly, about 5 minutes. Remove from oven.
Show off your creations and enjoy! (Serve macaroni & cheese directly in the baking dishes or transfer to plates.)
